# MeasureRange { #timetoalign.timelines.flow.MeasureRange }

```python
timelines.flow.MeasureRange(start, end, sections=())
```

A right-open range of measure counts, as a ``.flow.csv`` row states one.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name     | Type                                  | Description                                                                  |
|----------|---------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| start    | [int](`int`)                          | The count of the first measure.                                              |
| end      | [int](`int`)                          | The count of the measure behind the last one.                                |
| sections | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), ...\] | The names of the atomic sections the range covers, in the order of the axis. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> MeasureRange(1, 5, ("A",)).n_measures
4
```
